column1: # Your watch-list — the CSV that replaces the Excel sheet.
#   asset_class       crypto (Phase 1). stock/etf reserved for a later phase.
#   current_position  your CURRENT signed size: +long / -short / 0 flat (notional units)
#   target_notional   optional per-symbol size; blank = use --default-notional
#   ref_time          MANUAL start time for the BTC relative-strength gate.
#                     or epoch seconds/ms. Blank = gate skipped for that symbol.
#                     Time-only is read as KST (UTC+9); add Z or +00:00 for UTC.
